collection.description: A villager picks up an old lavastone bare-handed, and walks out into the light looking years older.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) was cleaning out an old storage hut when (subject.he/she) found a lavastone wrapped in faded cloth, and, without thinking, picked it up with (subject.his/her) bare hand. It flashed, silver-white, and went dark. Nothing hurt. But when (subject) walked out into the light, (friend) stopped and stared. (subject)'s hair has turned grey, and (subject.his/her) face looks years older than it did this morning.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) goes to the pool and looks at (subject.his/her) reflection for a long time. (subject.He/She) feels the same. (subject.He/She) is the same, inside. (subject.He/She) just looks like (subject.his/her) own grandparent now. (subject.He/She) isn't sure how (subject.he/she) feels about it. (friend) sits with (subject.him/her). "You look like you," (friend.he/she) says. "Just more." (subject) laughs, a bit shakily. It's a start.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) goes to the elders. They have heard of such stones, but none of them knows any way to undo what happened. One of them, (elder), with grey hair of (elder.his/her) own, takes (subject)'s hand and says, "Welcome. It's not so bad over here." (subject) isn't ready to agree. (subject.He/She) also isn't ready to be sad about it. (subject.He/She) goes home and thinks.
